lines.1: A smoke screen filled the kitchen.
lines.2: 「Whoa. This is one step short of a fire.」
lines.3: 「Impressive. When a frying pan produces this much flame, I feel like a Chinese chef.」
lines.4: 「No, you definitely used the wrong amount of oil.」
lines.6: 「But even as a test, not tasting it would be an insult to the ingredients.」
lines.7: With that, Otome began crunching through the charcoal, whose original form was impossible to identify.
lines.12: 「Today, make a circuit from the park to the station.」
lines.14: 「A delivery from my family arrives today. You will have to do the roadwork alone. The courier should be here soon.」
lines.15: 「Yeah, yeah. Got it. I'll go by myself.」
lines.16: This might be a little easier than usual.
